## Goal

Make the CI job green on `rebuild/v2` without weakening any check.

## Context

Verified 2026-11-27: build fails because `ECOMAIL_API_KEY`, `ECOMAIL_LIST_ID`, `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`, `TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` are missing from `ci.yml`. Audit fails with 6 high advisories (undici <7.30.1, happy-dom <=21.0.3). In a scratch copy, adding the 4 placeholders and overrides `undici: ^7.30.1`, `happy-dom: ^21.0.4` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` made typecheck, 894/894 tests, build and audit pass.

## Scope

- Add the 4 variables to `ci.yml` env with structurally valid, non-functional values and comments (Turnstile: Cloudflare documented always-pass test keys `1x00000000000000000000AA` / `1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA`; Ecomail: a placeholder key and a numeric list id).
- Raise `undici` override to `^7.30.1`, add `happy-dom: ^21.0.4`, regenerate `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
- Fix the contradictory comment in `src/lib/env.ts` about where the Turnstile site key lives.
- Check that `.env.example` documents all four (it does today; keep it).

## Out of scope

- Making any env var optional.
- Lowering `--audit-level`.
- Adding DB tests to CI (SC-011).
- Font changes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] CI run on the PR is green on all five steps.
- [ ] No `|| true`, no skipped steps, no removed tests.
- [ ] Payload admin rich-text editor still loads and saves a document locally (happy-dom is used by `@lexical/headless`).

## Required tests

- `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` (with CI env), `pnpm audit --audit-level high`: paste summary lines.

- SC-001
